# News Release


3/13/2026


South Bow Files 2025 Annual Disclosure Documents


CALGARY, Alta. – March 13, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow) filed its 2025 annual disclosure documents on March 13, 2026.
